reasoning: The right branch grows without bound as x→∞, so a=∞. The left branch approaches the horizontal line y=−2 as x→−∞, so b=−2. Math Academy's worked solution agrees with both limits.

answers.ma_evidence:
Therefore, $a = \infty.$

- On the left of the graph, we see that as $x$ gets more and more negative, the function $f(x)$ levels off to the value of $-2.$ We can express this as follows:

$$
f(x) \rightarrow -2 \quad \text{as} \quad x\rightarrow -\infty
$$

Therefore, $b = -2.$
